summary: Phase 0 capability re-attestation is complete and mechanically enforced.
findings: Schema v5 keeps 35 implementation flags separate from contract, behavior, default, and verified parity; only bounded CAP-0130 is attested, while 34 records and every unresolved P0 capability remain non-parity.
residual_risks: The 34 unresolved capability records and 13 runtime semantic violations are intentional inputs to later phases, not Phase 0 parity claims.
